name: KY Personal Water Based Lubricant 50gm Tube
description:
KY Jelly Gel Lubricant – 50g 💧
Made in China

Experience smooth and gentle lubrication with KY Jelly Gel, designed for everyday comfort and ease of use.

🔹 Easy to Handle: Soft jelly consistency for smooth application.

🔹 Daily Use: Mild formula, perfect for everyday intimate care.

KY Jelly Gel provides a comfortable, safe, and convenient solution for smooth intimacy and personal care.
